opening.argument: The offer identifies officesetups.co.uk as an Office setup support provider and shows what it sells: paid support plans, Office installation and upgrades, and computer-support services. Its call button provides a way to contact the service, while the described remote session is expressly subject to the caller's approval. Office-related branding is present, but the material presents a third-party service, not a claim that its experts are Microsoft employees. The visible plans make the charges apparent. Nothing in the supplied material shows unauthorized remote control or a deceptive charge. On this record, the promotion is for an ordinary paid support service, without evidence of the misrepresentation or unauthorized conduct that would change that reading.

citations.quote: We are the best and cost-effective office setup support service provider in UK.
